files_summary.jobs.json: Array of scheduled jobs (job_id, name, schedule, enabled, command).
files_summary.job_histories.json: Array of job run history (run_id, job_id, started_at, status, duration_s).
files_summary.README.md: Schema, lifecycles and business rules of this benchmark's datastore.

tool_schemas.name: scheduler_list_jobs
tool_schemas.description: Lists scheduled jobs and returns the matching job records, optionally filtered to only enabled or only disabled jobs. Refuses requests where the enabled filter is not a boolean.

enabled.description: Optional filter: only enabled or only disabled jobs.

tool_schemas.name: scheduler_get_job
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves a single scheduled job by job_id and returns the job record when it exists; if it does not exist, it returns an explicit not-found result instead of a job. Refuses requests missing job_id or where job_id is not a string.

tool_schemas.name: scheduler_create_job
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new scheduled job from a name, cron schedule string, and command, and returns the created job record. Refuses requests missing any of name, schedule, or command, or where any of those fields are not strings.

tool_schemas.name: scheduler_update_job
tool_schemas.description: Updates an existing job’s schedule and/or enabled state and returns the updated job record. Refuses requests missing job_id, where job_id is not a string, where schedule is provided but is not a string, where enabled is provided but is not a boolean, or where the referenced job does not exist.

tool_schemas.name: scheduler_delete_job
tool_schemas.description: Deletes the scheduled job identified by job_id and returns whether the deletion was applied. Refuses requests missing job_id, where job_id is not a string, or where the referenced job does not exist.

tool_schemas.name: scheduler_job_history
tool_schemas.description: Returns execution history entries, either for a specific job when job_id is provided or for all jobs when it is omitted. Refuses requests where job_id is provided but is not a string, or where a specified job_id does not correspond to any known job.

metadata.name: Clockwork Runbook Scheduler
metadata.description: A cron-style job scheduling service that lets users create, manage, and run recurring tasks while recording execution history and outcomes over time.
